title: NU banks on 'tribe' in bid for third straight UAAP cheerdance title
summary: The stage is set for another showcase of athleticism, creativity, and school pride as the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition takes center stage on Saturday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
